visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a person's hands pouring washed rice from a stainless steel bowl into a light pink pot on an induction cooktop. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from a nearby window. (2) High-inference: Broth, mirin, and salt are added to the pot with the rice. A small piece of dark green kombu is placed on top. The background shows a clean, modern kitchen with various cooking utensils in holders. (3) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a woman in a white shirt and pink apron cutting boiled spinach on a wooden cutting board. She uses a chef's knife to chop the greens into uniform lengths. (4) Shimeji mushrooms are shown being separated by hand and then having their woody bases trimmed off with a knife. The camera remains at a high eye-level, focusing on the hands and the food. (5) A raw salmon steak is presented in a heart-shaped pink bowl. Clear liquid is poured over it, followed by a sprinkle of salt and manual rubbing to season the fish. (6) Two eggs are cracked into a white bowl and whisked vigorously with wooden chopsticks until smooth. The whisked eggs are then poured into a hot, black frying pan. (7) The eggs are scrambled in the pan using a black spatula until they form soft, golden-brown clumps, then transferred to a plate. Shimeji mushrooms are added to the same pan and sautéed with seasonings. (8) The salmon steak is coated in white flour, shaken to remove excess, and placed into a hot pan with oil. It is fried until the skin is crispy and the flesh is golden-brown. (9) The cooked salmon is broken into small chunks using a fork, and bones are carefully removed. (10) The cooked rice is fluffed in the pink pot. Scrambled eggs, mushrooms, salmon, and spinach are added on top. Soy sauce and sesame oil are drizzled over the ingredients. (11) The mixture is thoroughly stirred until all ingredients are evenly distributed. White sesame seeds are sprinkled on top. (12) The woman (Rosalina) holds a plate of the finished 'Salmon and Spinach Mixed Rice', smells it with a joyful expression, and takes a large bite, giving two thumbs up to the camera.

There is a crisp sound of rice being poured into a pot and a liquid splash. (2) Rhythmic percussive chopping sounds occur as vegetables are cut, synchronized with the steady 125 BPM music tempo. (3) A distinct metallic clink of a lid is heard, followed by the sizzling sound of ingredients hitting a hot pan. The narration remains high-pitched and enthusiastic. (4) The sharp crack of an eggshell is heard, followed by the fast whisking sound of chopsticks against a ceramic bowl. Sizzling continues as eggs are fried. (5) Mechanical clicks of a salt shaker or pepper grinder are audible. The sound of a spatula scraping the bottom of a pan is prominent during sautéing. (6) A crispy, crackling sizzling sound accompanies the salmon frying. The narration tone rises in excitement as the dish nears completion. (7) Soft rustling and mixing sounds are heard as the ingredients are combined in the pot. (8) The narrator lets out an appreciative 'Wow!' followed by audible chewing sounds and a satisfied exclamation. The upbeat music swells slightly before fading out.
